library.html:
Interview details

Subject-matter expert
Role
Date and place
Attendees
Recording

Goals

Confirm the power-up sequence and the built-in test (BIT) the operator sees, for chapter 3 of the Operator Manual.

Questions and answers

What does the operator do first when powering up?

Main breaker on the rack, then the console switch. The console shows the boot screen for about 40 seconds before BIT starts.

Which BIT results stop the operator?

Any red result on the transmitter or the cooling loop. Amber results are logged and the operator may continue. Get the full list of amber codes from Yossi.
